texts.orig: Problem 1 | Understand the Application and Its Design
texts.text: Problem 1 | Understand the Application and Its Design

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A university food-delivery application reads its menu from CSV. A customer selects one meal, optionally adds extras, chooses a delivery method and places an order. The system assigns a courier, notifies the kitchen and customer, and saves the order in CSV. One meal per order; no database, GUI or external libraries are required.

table_cells.text: MealFactory creates Burger, Pizza or Sushi according to MenuItemData.type; reject unsupported types.
ComboSide wraps a Meal; add " + Combo Side" to its description and 25 EGP to its price.
ExpressDelivery reports "Express Delivery" and calculates a 30 EGP fee.
FleetManager provides one instance; assignCourier removes a courier from the available pool.
Order notifies registered observers on status changes; CustomerNotifier prints the order ID and status.
Calculate the strategy fee, assign courier, update Order, mark PLACED and append the CSV row.
OrderController registers both observers, invokes the Facade once and displays the completed order.
